limitations: Experimental macOS 13+ system-default same-GPU backend; tested on macOS 27.0.1 Apple Silicon only. RGBA8 read/write tier 2, shared events and MPS required. No silent CPU framebuffer fallback.
Physical webcam, Intel/eGPU switching and actual device removal are hardware-unverified. OS GPU-access revocation may require application restart.
Public Core Text native metrics, grayscale coverage and hinting differ from Skia; no pixel-identical text or full HDR/wide-gamut fidelity claim.
The CPU-only quartz reference has narrower coverage. Runtime WGSL translation is optional and increases executable size; minimal HelloWorld omits Naga.
Fifteen catalog pages cover the named gap regressions, not every interaction on 200+ pages. Tests of bounded batching/pooling do not establish production frame-rate, startup or memory parity.
Executable/gzip measurements exclude OS-supplied frameworks and are not installer/app-bundle sizes.
published_path_policy: Checkout-relative paths and ~/ home placeholders; recorded measurements and artifact/source hashes are unchanged.
privacy_history_policy: Personal paths, background process names and local device identifiers are omitted. Source commit IDs from the superseded branch are redacted; content hashes and measurements are historical and predate the upstream rebase.
